correctness.rationale: Direct verification of the exact affine-shell kernel and normalized rational generating function gives the stationary balances. The real-pole competition at 2 and r(p) proves the boundedness threshold p=6/7; the double-pole expansion is exact. The positive-drift lower bound and last-reset argument prove almost-sure escape for p<2/3. The Laplace transform limit proves critical exponential scaling. Finite exact-rational diagnostics independently check coefficients and branch itineraries, but do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The phase diagram is prompted by the original critical infinite-measure model. It gives distinct existence, endpoint regularity and scaling transitions at the natural parameters p=2/3 and p=6/7. The complete parameter-wide stationary depth generating function is a motivated exact invariant governing mass accumulation near the two attracting endpoints; the subcritical escape law completes the boundary picture. This is not merely a finite computation or an arbitrary isolated parameter.
